# llms.txt — machine-readable index
#
# A convention borrowed from github/awesome-copilot: a plain-text map that an AI agent can
# read to find what it needs without crawling the repository. Kept as a flat list so it stays
# parseable and so a diff of it is reviewable.
#
# Format: <path> — <what it is> — <when to read it>

# --- Repository meta -------------------------------------------------------------------

README.md — overview, quick start, contents table — start here
AGENTS.md — tool-neutral project instructions loaded by Copilot and other agents — always
REVIEW.md — code review instructions for this repository — when reviewing a change
CONTRIBUTING.md — contribution rules and the validator-rule process — before proposing a change
SECURITY.md — security surface and private reporting — when reporting a vulnerability
LICENSE — MIT

# --- Theory track ----------------------------------------------------------------------

docs/README.md — theory index, four parts, reading order — to navigate the track
docs/00-mental-model.md — the three mechanisms, context budget, surface map — always first
docs/01-custom-instructions.md — repository-wide instructions, scope, precedence, writing rules — when writing copilot-instructions.md
docs/02-path-scoped-instructions.md — applyTo glob semantics and overlap — when scoping instructions by path
docs/03-prompt-files.md — prompt files, frontmatter, variables, IDE-only status — when writing .prompt.md
docs/04-custom-agents.md — .agent.md, tool aliases, least privilege, levels, deduplication — when writing an agent
docs/05-skills.md — SKILL.md, progressive loading, allowed-tools, context fork, portability — when writing a skill
docs/06-hooks.md — hook events, JSON config, and the fail-closed/fail-open decision contract — when writing a hook
docs/07-mcp.md — MCP configuration paths, secret prefix, tool selection — when connecting external tools
docs/08-agent-environment.md — copilot-setup-steps.yml, honoured keys, runners, review override — when the agent needs dependencies
docs/09-policies-and-guardrails.md — what actually enforces vs what merely suggests — when designing governance
docs/10-composition-patterns.md — decision table and end-to-end recipes — when adopting for a team
docs/11-verification.md — discovery vs effectiveness, per-mechanism verification — when something does not work
docs/12-portability.md — Agent Skills standard, AGENTS.md, what does not port — when sharing across agents

# --- Practice track --------------------------------------------------------------------

labs/README.md — practice index, prerequisites, start-here path — to navigate the track
labs/01-first-instruction.md — write a repository-wide instruction and prove it lands
labs/02-path-scoped-instructions.md — prove a glob matches one file and not another
labs/03-prompt-file.md — run the security review prompt against a real defect
labs/04-first-agent.md — confirm a tool grant is a capability boundary
labs/05-first-skill.md — prove a skill is discovered, then prove it is effective
labs/06-hooks.md — exercise the hook decision contract without any Copilot surface
labs/07-mcp.md — inspect and verify MCP configuration
labs/08-agent-environment.md — audit copilot-setup-steps.yml against the honoured-keys rule
labs/09-guardrails.md — classify each control as instruction, capability or enforcement
labs/10-capstone.md — build a complete customization set with a self-review checklist

# --- Reference -------------------------------------------------------------------------

reference/cheat-sheet.md — one-page comparison of every feature, surface and mechanism
reference/frontmatter-reference.md — every property, type, requirement, limit and silent failure
reference/sources.md — official documentation index, the authority for every claim

# --- The live template -----------------------------------------------------------------

.github/copilot-instructions.md — repository-wide instructions, the always-on layer
.github/instructions/ — path-scoped instructions: typescript, tests, documentation, copilot config
.github/prompts/ — review-api-security, write-adr, triage-issue
.github/agents/ — code-reviewer (read-only), docs-writer, test-specialist, planner
.github/skills/ — changelog-entry, dependency-audit, code-review
.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md — forked-context review skill; name chosen so code review loads it
.github/hooks/guardrails.json — sessionStart, preToolUse x2, sessionEnd
.github/hooks/scripts/ — bash and PowerShell guardrails with the exit-code contract documented
.github/CODEOWNERS — makes the customization surface review-critical
.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml — agent environment, honoured keys documented inline
.github/workflows/copilot-code-review.yml — review-only environment override
.github/workflows/validate-customizations.yml — CI for the frontmatter contract
.vscode/mcp.json — editor MCP servers, token prompted not stored
examples/shop-api/ — fixed fixture with one intentional authorization defect
scripts/validate-customizations.mjs — dependency-free contract validator
scripts/test/ — 36 tests, including proof the validator writes nothing
